blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A taxi driver escaped a robbery attempt unharmed after keeping his composure and immediately calling for assistance, leading to the arrest of the suspect who held him at knifepoint. The incident occurred near the barangay hall in Barangay Ibo, Lapu-Lapu City, early Friday morning, October 23. According to a report released […]...
